item.title: Major Water Main Break in Jackson Square - Jamaica Plain News

item.title: Croft School Co-Founder Suspended; School Reportedly Millions in Debt - Jamaica Plain News
item.description: The co-founder of the Croft School has been suspended after reportedly misrepresenting the school’s finances, resulting in a $13 million debt and a need for $5 million to keep the school open for the rest of the school year. item.title: Batey Comunitario at Hyde Square Task Force Celebrates Boston’s Afro-Latin Culture - Jamaica Plain News
item.description: Hyde Square Task Force (HSTF) hosted a Batey Comunitario for the local community to celebrate Afro-Latin culture. The event, held on March 12, featured live music and dancing lessons inspired by the practice of Bomba, one of Puerto Rico’s oldest music and dance traditions, originating in the 17th century from enslaved people on coastal sugar plantations.
